_comment: AgentHub MCP Server — Add this block to your Claude Code / Claude Desktop config.

agenthub.description: AgentHub AI Marketplace — 5 MCP tools: list_models, run_inference, audit_model, execute_code, orchestrate

_tools: list_models    — Browse 51+ Hugging Face model endpoints (filterable by domain)
run_inference  — LLM completion against any model_id (non-streaming)
audit_model    — Full 5-probe OWASP LLM-as-a-Judge red-team security audit
execute_code   — Isolated Python subprocess execution with 5s hard timeout
orchestrate    — Natural-language goal → Groq Meta-Agent DAG decomposition
_quick_start: 2. Copy the 'mcpServers.agenthub' block into your Claude Desktop config.
3. Replace <YOUR_HF_TOKEN> and <YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY> with real values from .env.
4. Restart Claude Desktop — AgentHub tools appear in the tool selector.
5. Try: 'Use the list_models tool to show CODE GEN models'
